The '''Chief of Special Forces Command''' was in command of [[Special Forces Command (Rebel Alliance)|Special Forces Command]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the being in command was [[General/Legends|General]] [[Crix Madine/Legends|Crix Madine]].
